description: For deductively closed propositional theories \(T,S\), \(F_T\subseteq F_S\) exactly when \(T\subseteq S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory_inclusion.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed S) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory T hT ≤
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory S hS ↔
    T ⊆ S
